points.reached by: RTL direct read of bus_req_i.data in sim_tx
points.reason: In simulation mode the supplied byte is written to the screen and log file, exposing the payload outside the UART transmit path.
The receiver samples the input into its synchronizer and shift register, while its timing and state conditions can corrupt or prevent byte assembly.
The assembled byte is presented to the receive FIFO and can be withheld when the receive-complete strobe is absent.
The another-IP FIFO is assumed to store received write data and return it through rdata_o; its clear, write, and read controls can discard or withhold the byte under the black-box rule.
A bus read returns rx_fifo.rdata in bus_rsp_o.data, exposing the received byte through the response path.
The sampled CTS value can keep the transmitter in its wait state and prevent transmission from advancing.
The RTS process drives the peer-facing handshake, and an asserted unavailable value can block incoming transfers.
The receive interrupt output is computed from configuration and FIFO status, so it can be suppressed or falsely asserted.
Bus writes change the receive interrupt enables and the enable gate, allowing the indication to be made wrong or suppressed.
Under the another-IP black-box rule, FIFO status outputs determine the interrupt conditions and can cause a missed or spurious interrupt.
The transmit interrupt output is computed from configuration and FIFO status, so it can be suppressed or falsely asserted.
Bus writes change the transmit interrupt enables and enable gate, allowing the indication to be made wrong or suppressed.
Under the another-IP black-box rule, FIFO status outputs determine the interrupt conditions and can cause a missed or spurious interrupt.
The overrun register is cleared by enable and set when a receive write occurs with no FIFO space, so its status can be changed.
This point only reads the overrun status into a bus response and does not itself modify the stored status.
The bus-programmable enable state is the source of the clock-generator request, so changing it can alter or remove that request.
The output directly carries ctrl.enable, and forcing it inactive can remove the UART source-clock request.
